title: German Chocolate Mousse
description: A rich and creamy German-inspired dessert made with velvety chocolate mousse, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: In a double boiler, melt the dark chocolate over low heat, stirring occasionally.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Add the Portuguese custard and granulated sugar to the whipped cream and mix until combined.
Fold the whipped cream mixture into the melted chocolate until well combined.
Spoon the German chocolate mousse into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until set.
Serve chilled, garnished with unsalted butter if desired.
